import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    array = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    balance = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        delta = 1 if (array[i] & 1) == 0 else -1
        balance[i] = (0 if i == 0 else balance[i-1]) + delta

    costs = []
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if balance[i] == 0:
            costs.append(abs(array[i+1] - array[i]))

    costs.sort()

    total = 0
    cuts = 0
    for cost in costs:
        total += cost
        if total > b:
            break
        cuts += 1

    print(cuts)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
